O. I. D.
No. 284
Date 8/6/16

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

June 8th 1916.

Sir,
All the Chinese newspapers with the exception
of the organs of the Kuo Ming Tang party, are printed
to-day in red, which is a sign that they welcome
the new regime and intend to support Li Yuan Hung.
It appears the Kuo Ming Tang 革命黨 papers are
withholding their support until they see how Li
deals with the monarchial plotters.

The Ningpo and Shaoshing Guild in Shanghai
have issued circulars requesting all residents
to hoist flags on 8th, 9th, and 10th instants
In honour of the new President.

It is reported that there is a slight feeling
of unrest among the troops in Woosung.

It is reported that General Yang has received
a telegram from the Central Government requesting him
to watch the movements of Liang Shih Yi, who has
fled from Peking.

Your Obedient Servant,
（手写签名）
Chief Detective Inspector.

（左侧手写批注：Entered on m.s. June 8.）

Captain Superintendent of Police.
pages.zh:
O. I. D.
第 284 号
日期 16/6/8

上海工部局。

（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探股。）

1916年6月8日。

先生：

除国民党机关报外，所有中文报纸今日均以红字印刷，此乃欢迎新政权并意图支持黎元洪之标志。看来，国民党革命党报刊正暂缓表示支持，以观黎氏如何处置君主制阴谋者。

上海的宁波会馆与绍兴会馆已发布通告，要求所有居民于本月8日、9日及10日悬挂旗帜，以向新任总统致敬。

据报，吴淞驻军中存在轻微的不安情绪。

据报，杨将军已收到中央政府电报，要求其监视已从北京出逃的梁士诒的动向。

您顺从的仆人，
（手写签名）
总探长。

（左侧手写批注：已于6月8日录入手稿。）

警务总监上尉。
